::: {#rem-kraft-source}
#### Where Kraft's inequality comes from

@cover2006elements [section 5.2] prove @thm-kraft-inequality and @thm-kraft-converse.
They show in section 5.5 that every [uniquely decodable code](source-coding.qmd#def-uniquely-decodable) satisfies the same inequality,
so restricting to prefix codes costs nothing in expected length.
@mackay2003information [section 5.2] states the inequality for prefix codes as well.

:::
